method: Two independent session agents each received only a synthetic brief and the skill resources, then authored and self-reviewed their own designs in isolated temporary folders. No intended design answers were supplied. PDF presentation checks are recorded separately after the output-format update.

cases.brief: I need a system for a small city team to handle streetlight repair requests: classify reports, find existing tickets and route to the right maintenance crew. Five operators handle about 200 reports a day. It must not remotely control equipment.

Design a small daily report that joins two CSV files by order ID. One has promised-delivery timestamps and the other actual-delivery timestamps, both ISO UTC. Flag delivered orders more than 24 hours late and export a CSV for the operations team. No emails, remote updates, forecasting or conversational interface.

limitations: The semantic design scores are author self-review, not independent grading or empirical accuracy.
Helper execution checks formats and relations; business integrations and generated control assertions were not executed.
Only these two of the six supplied regression briefs were forward-tested.
No extra provider keys, real accounts or business-system actions were used.
observedRepairs: Co-located design/review/export input protection fixed before publication.
Nonterminal terminalDisposition and shared successor predicates aligned with documented contract.
Inapplicable rollout experiment field validation corrected after forward feedback.
PDF made primary, avoiding repeated raw-packet presentation; optional HTML is opt-in.
